ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: For the RC circuit shown in Figure 4, if \(u_o\) leads \(u_i\) by \(30^\circ\), what is the relationship among \(\omega\), \(C\), and \(R\)?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the left side is the input voltage source u_i, with the upper terminal marked “+” and the lower terminal marked “-”; a capacitor C is connected in series at the top of the circuit, and after the capacitor it is connected to the right-side node; this node is connected through resistor R to the bottom common loop, so R is a parallel branch to ground; the output u_o marked on the right side is the voltage across the two ends of resistor R. Reasoning: By the voltage division relationship, U_o/U_i = R/(R + 1/(jωC)). Simplifying gives U_o/U_i = jωCR/(1 + jωCR). The phase of this transfer function is 90° - tan^(-1)(ωCR). The problem states that u_o leads u_i by 30°, so 90° - tan^(-1)(ωCR) = 30°, that is, tan^(-1)(ωCR) = 60°. Therefore ωCR = tan 60° = √3.

Write the voltage divider transfer function U_o/U_i=R/(R+1/(jωC)). Simplify it to jωRC/(1+jωRC), compute its phase as 90°−tan^{-1}(ωRC), equate this to 30°, and solve for the required relationship among ω, C, and R.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the input source drives a series capacitor and resistor, and the labeled output is across the resistor. From the text, use the fact that this resistor voltage leads the input source voltage by 30°. Draw the phasor triangle: take U_o=U_R along the current axis, take U_C downward by 90°, and form U_i as their sum. The angle by which U_o leads U_i satisfies tan(30°)=|U_C|/|U_R|. Substitute |U_C|=I/(ωC) and |U_R|=IR, then solve for ωCR.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路图左侧是交流输入电压源 u_i，上端标“+”、下端标“-”。从输入源上端经过一个电容 C 接到右侧上节点；右侧有一个电阻 R 从上节点接到底部公共节点。输出 u_o 标在右侧端口处，箭头向下，表示输出电压取在电阻 R 两端。

推理：该电路是串联 RC 电路，输出 u_o 就是电阻电压 U_R。串联电路中电流相同，取电流方向为参考，则 U_R 与电流同相，电容电压 U_C 滞后电流 90°。输入电压 U_i 是 U_R 与 U_C 的相量和，因此 U_o=U_R 会超前 U_i 一个角度。题设给出 u_o 超前 u_i 为 30°，所以相量三角形中有 tan 30° = |U_C| / |U_R|。代入 |U_C| = I/(ωC)，|U_R| = IR，得到 tan 30° = [I/(ωC)]/(IR) = 1/(ωCR)。因为 tan 30° = 1/√3，所以 1/(ωCR)=1/√3，解得 ωCR=√3。
